turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Hey, how's your day been so far?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Really good, actually.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I'm throwing a surprise party for my best friend's thirtieth.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Oh, nice. How many people?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Maybe twenty.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Good size. Do you want a sit down dinner at a restaurant, or a relaxed evening at someone's place?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Just a sec, I need to sort something out with my roommate. I'll say when I'm back.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Did you book the cinema for Saturday?

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: Not yet. I wasn't sure which film you wanted.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I don't mind. Anything but horror.

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: There's that comedy everyone's talking about.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Fine by me. What time does it start?

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: There's a seven o'clock and a nine thirty.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Seven, so we can eat after.

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: Booking it now.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Okay, all done here, back to the game.

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: Finally!

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Nina, did you call the landlord?

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: Not yet, I'll do it tonight.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Okay, back. Thanks for being patient.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Alright. Still thinking about the setting for the surprise party?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: A restaurant. Nobody has room for twenty people.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Makes sense. Ask about a private room, it makes the surprise moment much easier.
